Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Mizoram Network Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Network Engineer post at NIT Mizoram is 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Network Engineer in NIT Mizoram?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Network Engineer post in the National Institute of Technology Mizoram recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Mizoram Network Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Network Engineer post at NIT Mizoram is through Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Network Engineer position at NIT Mizoram?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Network Engineer position at NIT Mizoram will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to the Network Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Network Engineer post should be between 18 and 35 years of age. Age relaxation may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Network Engineer post?
faq.answer: Applicants must have a Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering / IT or Equivalent or above from a recognized Board/University/Institute with valid CCNP/CCNA Certification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500 for the NIT Mizoram Network Engineer recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee for the Network Engineer post at NIT Mizoram.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Network Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Network Engineer post at NIT Mizoram primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the Network Engineer post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Network Engineer post is Aizawl, Mizoram, with the pincode 796012, at the National Institute of Technology Mizoram campus.
